_comment: Search terms per role family: SDE/software engineering and backend engineering only (DevOps, SRE, platform, cloud, QA/testing and dedicated AI/ML searches were removed). A family is used when a desired role in job-profile.md matches one of its 'roles' patterns (regex). Queries run in the listed order, round-robin across families and locations. 'kind': plain = plain role (suitable jobs do not always say junior/fresher), early = early-career title or experience term. Desired roles that match no family are searched as plain roles.
_city_comment: Cities a service request may choose, with the SerpApi location string for each. Add a city here to allow it.
